package.description: SanDisk PrivateAccess tool for creating passwords, encrypting and backup.

en-US.description: SanDisk PrivateAccess tool for creating passwords, encrypting and backup.
en-US.longDescription:
PrivateAccess features the ability to：
• Create a password to keep others from accessing protected data
• Encrypt and protect critical and sensitive files
• Backup and restore encrypted data
Supported Products：
SanDisk Phone Drive, iXpand USB, USB Flash, Wireless Charger Sync, Extreme Portable, Extreme PRO Portable
